section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study conducted in Portugal with 155 participants (44 males, 111 females) aged 18-35 years. Males had a slightly higher mean age (22.36 years) compared to females (21.30 years), and the sample reported a mean BMI of 22.63, which was classified as normal-weighted. BMI was assessed through self-reported measures and differed slightly between genders, with males having a higher mean BMI (23.54) than females (22.28).
